description: This PHP class is a client for the AWS DataSync service, providing method signatures to interact with various DataSync API operations including creating, describing, updating, and deleting resources related to data synchronization in AWS. It extends a base AWS client class and uses PHPDoc annotations to declare method signatures and their asynchronous counterparts.
